concepts.def: Point on horizon where parallel lines meet.
Perspective with a single vanishing point.
Object appears shorter as it points at viewer.
Lines that run to the vanishing point.

walkthroughs.body_html: Draw a horizon line across your page at eye level. Mark a vanishing point on it. All depth lines (orthogonals) head to that point.
A road or corridor is perfect for one-point perspective. Verticals stay vertical, horizontals stay horizontal, and only the depth lines converge.
Place two vanishing points on the horizon, one on each side. Each side of a building runs to its own point. This is how street-corner views are drawn.
